title: 第二十二章送别宴
novel_title: 开局阴阳宗，从反杀师姐开始斩妖除魔
content_zh:
当日，天朗气清，惠风和畅。

    浓郁的血腥味充斥在空气之中，让路过的大雁，都下意识避开这片区域。

    底下，一片狼藉，一抹巨大的血坑出现在场地中央，上面没有一丝残留，只有一层浓厚的血迹。

    此刻，那些刚刚不在场的人，也是听见动静，从营房里走了出来。

    有些管后勤的妇人在看见这一惨状之后，先是下意识地一阵反胃，然后惊悚地捂住嘴巴，蹲下身去。

    有些胆子还算大的男子则是来到血坑边缘，看着那种惨样，反倒是没有那么悲伤，其中更多的是一抹庆幸。

    他们为非作歹那么久，干了那么多坏事，终于死了。

    这样的想法不在少数，而是充斥在这里大多数人心中。

    来这里的人定然犯下了什么罪行，只不过有大有小。

    有些人可能就是因为顶撞了一下权贵，就来了这里。

    因为本性不坏，生活还算老实，平日所求，只有一个安稳。

    可有些人却是相反，明明犯下了什么滔天大罪，反而因为家里的实力，免去死罪，得以来到这里。

    当然本性难改，改不了吃屎。

    所以，那些老实人就成了他们欺负的对象。

    平日里的欺压自然不在少数。

    有些人朝里面啐了一口唾沫，但也有些人却还是在后怕。

    他们也是够幸运的，平日里坏事不少，现在却是侥幸躲了过去。

    但瞅着那些平日里一起耀武扬威的同伴，如今就连骨灰都没有。

    顿时浑身冷汗直冒。

    家里还有那么多钱，可不能就这么死了……他们赶紧乘着这股乱，彼此商量了一下，收拾东西，准备夜晚就跑路。

    张守安凭借自身的听觉，自然也是察觉到了这些人的私语，只不过他倒是没管。

    随他们去吧，自己懒得管了，反正这里妖物这么多，他们估计刚走出几步，就变成肥料了。

    不过在此，他耳边迟到的系统声终于响起，但语音不断，就像卡了一般。

    【击杀练气中期人类】

    【击杀练气初期人类】

    【击杀练气初期人类】

    ……

    【价值评估中…】
content_en:
That day, the sky was clear and the wind was gentle and gentle.

The strong smell of blood filled the air, causing the geese passing by to avoid this area subconsciously.

There was a mess underneath, and a huge blood puddle appeared in the center of the field. There was no residue on it, only a thick layer of blood.

At this moment, those who were not present just now heard the noise and came out of the barracks.

After seeing this tragic scene, some women in charge of logistics first felt nauseated subconsciously, then covered their mouths in horror and squatted down.

Some brave men came to the edge of the blood pit. Looking at the miserable scene, they were not so sad, but more of a sense of joy.

They had been evil for so long, done so many bad things, and finally died.

Such thoughts are not in the minority, but fill the minds of most people here.

The people who came here must have committed some kind of crime, some big or some small.

Some people may come here just because they contradicted the powerful.

Because his nature is not bad, his life is quite honest, and all he wants is stability.

But some people are on the contrary. They have obviously committed some heinous crime, but because of their family's strength, they are exempted from the death penalty and are able to come here.

Of course, nature is hard to change, and eating shit cannot be changed.

Therefore, those honest people became the targets of their bullying.

Of course, daily bullying is not uncommon.

Some people spat inside, but some people were still afraid.

They are also lucky enough. They usually have a lot of bad things, but now they are lucky enough to escape.

But looking at the companions who usually show off their strength together, now they don't even have ashes.

Suddenly he broke out in cold sweat.

The family still had so much money, so they couldn't just die... They quickly took advantage of the chaos, discussed with each other, packed their things, and prepared to run away at night.

Zhang Shou'an naturally noticed these people's whispers with his own hearing, but he didn't care.

Let them be, they are too lazy to care. There are so many monsters here anyway, they will probably become fertilizer as soon as they take a few steps.

But here, the belated system sound finally sounded in his ears, but the voice continued, as if it was stuck.

[Kill a human in the middle stage of Qi training]

[Killing humans in the early stage of Qi training]

[Killing humans in the early stage of Qi training]

…

【Under evaluation...】
